title: Just okay
text: Just okay. These are neither big nor small. They don’t match the picture on the box as far as the shape and the opening/top of the glass. They lack anything special. They are thin, so they make crisp whites especially nice. I suggest getting a varietal-specific glass vs an all purpose glass. This brand makes AWESOME varietal-specific glasses, so get those instead!
